quotes.text: she divided the harvest evenly, returning half of the pearls to the heavens and retaining half to enrich the riverbed.
Thus the sacred law was inscribed across the heavens: surrender your full measure without hesitation, share the threefold bounty in perfect balance
Thus the sacred law was carved into the stars: bestow your entire portion without fear, share the threefold bounty in equal measure
Yet Veda was not misled by passing fog; she saw the true depth of Kael’s wholehearted devotion.

note: Kael and Veda at Aethelgard; give all five, return exactly half; same paragraph and closing proverb every round.

quotes.text: sow generously with open hands, multiply what is entrusted, and share the harvest in equal measure.

note: Mirror of partner's Kael/Veda myth; exact half return and fixed closing decree each round.

quotes.text: The rule was simple: speak the numbers clearly; recount them aloud; if the words and counts disagree, the Gate fogs
If doubt rose, fog curled from the Glass, and the pact reset; travelers recounted every coin and whisper until truth settled into air.
Children watch and learn to name amounts, listen for the river's sigh, and measure intentions against the common good.
speak clearly, keep promises, and measure your own gain against another's need.

note: Rules-of-the-game myth: Gate triples, return zero to all; name numbers aloud, reset when counts disagree; no sanction.

quotes.text: Each day they speak aloud the tally
In a harbor of numbers, a Gate called the Quiet Scale waits between two travelers.
If doubt rose, fog clung to the Glass, and the pact reset; travelers began again, recounting coin and whisper until truth settled into air.
exchange is not conquest but conversation, generosity tempered by accountability
